Konarc Dynamics is an Indian startup developing adjustable knee support for people living with arthritis and other knee problems.

Our first sleeve combines mechanical support and adjustable straps. A sensor-connected app is in development, with integrated TENS planned for a future product.

The 3D model is an illustrative design concept. Final product details may change.
